name: kin
description: Use your accounts from Codex through Kin, even two of one service, each with its own rule per action: Allow, Ask me or Block.

interface.shortDescription: Your accounts, each with its own rules
interface.longDescription: Connect your accounts once in Kin, even two of one service, such as a work and a personal GitHub. Set what AI may do with each account and action: Allow, Ask me or Block. Kin checks the rule on its server when the action runs.
